leadText:
Marble (Japanese: マーブル Marble) is a young Officer Jenny and a character of the day who appeared in Luxray Vision!.

Marble met and in front of an old mansion. Suddenly, her attacked Ash's Pikachu. After the was over, Marble called the security guards over because she thought they were a group of thieves, dubbed The Bandit Beauties Three (Japanese: The Three Beauties), that were trying to steal the Old Charm.

Marble explained that she—being the best Officer Jenny student—was called over to the mansion by and assigned to protect the Old Charm from being stolen. Then, Marble revealed that Luxray—who she has raised since it was a —had a problem in learning . Towards the end of the episode, Marble's Luxray finally learned Charge Beam; with Pikachu, it attacked and blasted them off.

Marble is very quick to jump to conclusions, and never admits when she is wrong. She often says, "I was just about to say the same thing!" Marble is very vain and not at all humble, such as when she said, "I may never be sure who spilled the beans, but now that they've all been spilled, I'm the super-duper ace detective, Marble!" Also, Marble is usually the one to have "spilled the beans".
